notes: Fixes a bug where the app killed a stream that was downloading perfectly fine. The stall detector only watched buffered playback time, which stays at zero while a large file's header is still being read -- so it wrongly declared a healthy download dead and stopped it. It now also watches actual bytes arriving. Additionally, if the backup player fails to start, the main player is restarted instead of being left stopped forever, and the reason is recorded in the Playback info panel.
